snippet.title: Helix: Descent N Ascent - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736370/Helix_Descent_N_Ascent/

As the last of your kind, many questions will arise. How far will you go to find the answers? Helix: Descent N Ascent, an emotional adventure into the depths of a forgotten world. 

Follow us on social media:
Discord: https://discord.gg/VVj86bKUdf

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/badass_mongoose/
